purpose: Evidence-aware relationship graph connecting the 23 deeply expanded religious-adjacent records. Edges represent historical, organizational, textual or comparative relationships and are not claims of equivalence.

nodes.name: Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn
Process Church of the Final Judgment

edges.basis: Golden Dawn drew institutional and symbolic material from Masonic and Rosicrucian environments.
Golden Dawn emerged in the Victorian Rosicrucian revival environment.
Hermetic material became part of the Golden Dawn's ritual and symbolic curriculum.
Crowley's early occult formation occurred within the Golden Dawn milieu before Thelema.
Early OTO was assembled from Masonic-derived rites.
Reuss and the early OTO operated in Rosicrucian and related esoteric milieus.
OTO developed alongside Theosophy in the early twentieth-century occult revival.
Crowley reorganized OTO as a principal institutional vehicle for Thelema.
Steiner led the German Section before breaking with Theosophy and developing Anthroposophy.
Both belonged to the wider late nineteenth-century occult revival and exchanged people and ideas through overlapping networks.
Anthroposophy formed after Steiner's break with the Theosophical Society.
Rosicrucian texts and later societies incorporated Hermetic and alchemical concepts.
Rosicrucianism was part of the Western esoteric source environment used by Theosophy.
Theosophical literature drew on Western esoteric and Hermetic traditions alongside Asian sources.
Crowley's magical system incorporated Hermetic and related Western esoteric materials.
Scholarly histories identify Crowley and Western occultism as part of the broader precursive environment for modern Satanism; this is not organizational succession.
Temple of Set formed in 1975 following Aquino's break from the Church of Satan.
The Church of Satan is one of the major codifications of modern self-identified Satanism.
Temple of Set emerged from modern Satanism while developing a distinct Setian identity.
Oxford scholarship treats the Process Church as a major case in modern Satanism's history.
ONA is studied within the history of modern Satanism and post-Satanic occultism.
TST is a contemporary Satanic movement with a distinct non-theistic and activist profile.
TST explicitly distinguishes itself from LaVey's Church of Satan.
The Temple of Set adopts the ancient Egyptian god Set as a central modern religious symbol; continuity is not assumed.
Academic research documents political-esoteric intersections involving ONA-associated figures.
Scholarship documents intersections with radical-right, National Socialist and other extremist milieus involving associated figures.
Process theology combined Christian figures with Satanic and Luciferian symbolism.
The movement's published theology explicitly incorporated Satan and Lucifer into its cosmology.
Orphic-Bacchic materials overlap in themes of Dionysus, purification and afterlife.
Both formed part of the diverse Greek mystery environment, without implying direct institutional descent.
Gold tablets and Orphic-Bacchic evidence connect Dionysian imagery with funerary and initiatory traditions.
Isis became associated with initiation in Hellenistic and Roman contexts, alongside older Greek mystery traditions.
Isiac temples and imperial cult institutions operated within the same Roman religious pluralist environment.
Mithraic communities existed within the imperial religious system without being identical to state cult.
Saturn's civic cult belonged to Roman public religious institutions alongside imperial cult.
Punic molk inscriptions and Tophet archaeology are relevant to the disputed interpretation of mōlek.
Later occult and astrological traditions transformed Saturn into a symbol of time, limitation and melancholy.
Hermetic texts became deeply associated with later alchemical traditions.
Later Hermetic traditions intersected strongly with astrology, while ancient and Renaissance layers must remain distinct.
Alchemy is prominent in Rosicrucian manifestos and later Rosicrucian organizations.
Golden Dawn incorporated Tarot into its correspondence and ritual curriculum.
Crowley infused OTO with Thelemic philosophy and reorganized its ritual framework.
Rudolf Steiner's leadership in the German Theosophical Section preceded Anthroposophy.
Steiner's 1924 Agriculture Course became the basis of biodynamic agriculture.
Waldorf education developed from Steiner's educational work and anthroposophical milieu.
Modern Satanism developed in a secularizing environment but is not equivalent to state atheism or anti-religious politics.
Both operate in secularized societies but differ sharply in goals, organization and religious self-understanding.
Theosophy positioned spiritual and esoteric knowledge against reductive materialism, while not constituting a simple anti-materialist political movement.

integrity_rules: A relationship edge is not proof of direct borrowing unless the evidence explicitly supports transmission.
Shared historical environment is not the same as institutional descent.
Modern movements using ancient names are not treated as continuous ancient institutions without evidence.
Extremist relationships are documented with attribution and do not imply that every member or reader shares the associated ideology.
Comparative edges remain distinct from causal historical edges.
